verdict.rationale: First-party homepage copy confirms an official Muse app on Mac alongside mobile and WhatsApp, so a desktop client exists. Nothing in the evidence shows OS-level shortcuts or the ability to see or use what is on the user's screen; Muse's own computer is a separate VM, not the user's desktop. Missing for 10: OS-level/global keyboard shortcuts, screen-awareness or screen-content access, Windows/Linux desktop apps, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Mac app's capabilities.
